# Required packages: survey, margins, lme4 (optional), mediation (optional)
library(survey)
library(margins)
library(lme4)
# df: your DHS individual-level dataset
# Variables assumed: contraceptive (0/1), edu_years, cnorm_z (country-level standardized), age, urban (0/1), country, sample_weight, strata, psu

# mean-center edu and cnorm
df$edu_c <- df$edu_years - mean(df$edu_years, na.rm=TRUE)
# ensure cnorm is country-level: create df_country and merge if needed; here assume cnorm_z already standardized
df$cnorm_c <- df$cnorm_z  # already mean=0, sd=1

# survey design
dclus <- svydesign(id=~psu, strata=~strata, weights=~sample_weight, data=df, nest=TRUE)

# logistic with interaction and country fixed effects
model_svy <- svyglm(contraceptive ~ edu_c * cnorm_c + age + urban + factor(country),
                    design=dclus, family=quasibinomial())

summary(model_svy)

# Marginal effect of edu at -1, 0, 1 SD of cnorm
for(v in c(-1,0,1)){
  print(margins(model_svy, variables="edu_c", at=list(cnorm_c=v)))
}

# Optional: multilevel model (random intercept)
m_ml <- glmer(contraceptive ~ edu_c * cnorm_c + age + urban + (1|country),
              family=binomial(link="logit"), data=df)
summary(m_ml)
